packages.name: service-worker-builder
packages.purpose: Implements a service worker with Workbox for caching, offline fallback and background sync.

packages.name: i18n-string-extractor
packages.purpose: Finds hard-coded UI strings, moves them to message catalogs with ICU syntax and wires the i18n library.

packages.name: i18n-locale-qa
packages.purpose: QAs localised builds for truncation, plural errors, untranslated strings, Intl formatting and RTL layout.

packages.name: mobile-crash-triager
packages.purpose: Groups crash reports by root cause, symbolicates stack traces, and proposes fixes ranked by affected users.

packages.name: mobile-a11y-auditor
packages.purpose: Audits iOS/Android/RN/Flutter screens for screen-reader labels, dynamic type, contrast and touch targets.

packages.name: mobile-deep-link-verifier
packages.purpose: Verifies universal/app link association files, routing and fallback behaviour across install states.

packages.name: mobile-sync-reviewer
packages.purpose: Reviews offline sync and push handling code for data loss, conflict and duplicate-delivery bugs.
